preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(line.split()[0]) <= 100 and 1 <= int(line.split()[1]) <= 100 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each test case contains two integers x and y, where 1 ≤ x, y ≤ 100.
The first line contains an integer t (1 ≤ t ≤ 10^4), the number of test cases.

postconditions.expression: all((stdout.splitlines()[i].strip() == '0 0' and y < x) or (stdout.splitlines()[i].strip() != '0 0' and (x * (int(b)**int(a)) == y and int(a) > 0 and int(b) > 0)) for i, line in enumerate(stdin.splitlines()[1:], 1))
postconditions.description: For each test case, if no solution exists (y < x), output '0 0'. Otherwise, output integers a and b such that x * (b^a) = y, with a > 0 and b > 0.

postconditions.expression: all((stdout.splitlines()[i].strip() == '0 0' and y % x != 0) or (stdout.splitlines()[i].strip() != '0 0' and (y % x == 0 or x == y)) for i, line in enumerate(stdin.splitlines()[1:], 1))
postconditions.description: If y is not divisible by x and x != y, no solution exists (output '0 0'). Otherwise, a solution exists.

postconditions.expression: all((stdout.splitlines()[i].strip() != '0 0' and (int(a) <= 10**9 and int(b) <= 10**9)) for i, line in enumerate(stdin.splitlines()[1:], 1) if stdout.splitlines()[i].strip() != '0 0')
postconditions.description: If a solution exists, the output integers a and b are each ≤ 10^9.
